scope: All11 prepared physical/control scenes,320uniqueEXRs(160currentengine+160preservedPBRT). Constant/ramp absorption oracle equivalence plus four scattering ratio mean/noise/depth controls. This is a numerical verification receipt, not Stage3 image acceptance or isolated performance evidence.

prepared_scope.means: Pre-existing protocol bands and independent oracle enclosures for absorption; within-renderer vacuum-normalized PBRT comparison for scattering.
prepared_scope.uncertainty: 4independentseeds. Whole-run units; nestedSPP/depth are paired prefixes. Independent backends. No pixel-independence errors.
prepared_scope.depth_tail: Scattering depth16→32 paired by seed at1024SPP.
prepared_scope.render_scopes: Absorption256/1024/4096SPP SPF8; scatter64/256/1024SPP anddepth32 SPF1. Same actual receipt metadata; no one-shot isolated performance claim.

noise_interpretation: Convergence passed the stated decrease criterion. Engine/PBRT globalY variance ratios at1024SPP scatter are1.5244–1.7536; equal noise is explicitly not established or required. Differences in valid estimators remain separate from mean-equivalence acceptance.
limitations: Existing oracle images and geometry-selected masks are hash checked and reused, not ray-integrated/re-rasterized again in this arithmetic review.

Absorption variance-bootstrap intervals were not regenerated; raw endpoint variances and existing interval status checked. Scatter variance-bootstrap bounds independently regenerated from explicit resampled arrays.
Four seeds and non-simultaneous regional intervals do not establish arbitrary-scene correctness or nominal coverage under all distributions.
PNG individual visual QA is separately owned by producer. No new GPU/render/source edits.
Stage3 host-glass/render results and Stage4 isolated slowdown tests remain separate.
